locale.label: Interface language
inference.title: Inference
settings.chunkHelp: Audio collected for each incremental decode. Lower values update sooner but run inference more often; higher values add latency and context.
settings.audioWindowHelp: Maximum recent audio reprocessed by each update. Older stable text is retained separately, keeping long-session latency and model context bounded.
settings.unfixedChunksHelp: Opening chunks decoded without using the previous transcript as a prefix. Higher values let early wording remain revisable for longer.
settings.unfixedTokensHelp: Trailing tokens removed before the previous transcript is reused as context. Higher values let more recent words be corrected and reduce boundary jitter.
api.title: API status
api.refreshPrompt: Select Refresh to query the API.
system.title: System
system.realtimeDefaultsHelp: Persistent starting values for new browser and API realtime sessions. Individual API requests can still override them.
system.defaultsSaved: Realtime defaults saved to persistent storage.
mcp.title: MCP connectivity
mcp.description: Allow trusted AI agents to inspect deployment health, transcribe shared files, and use runtime controls. This is not authentication; keep the service on a trusted private network.
mcp.enableHelp: Persist access to /mcp across container restarts.
mcp.locationPending: Endpoint and shared file directory are being detected…
aligner.title: Forced aligner
aligner.description: Word and caption-style segment timestamps use an additional multilingual Qwen3-ForcedAligner model. Unchecking both timestamp options releases it after 60 seconds unless it is kept loaded here. First load can add roughly 3.3 GiB of VRAM; some compiled CUDA context may remain cached after release.
aligner.keepLoadedHelp: Persist this preference and load the model during every startup.
aligner.loadedToast: Forced aligner loaded. Timestamp output is ready.
aligner.unusedReleased: Unused forced aligner released from VRAM.
aligner.persistEnabled: Aligner will remain loaded across restarts.
aligner.persistDisabled: Persistent aligner loading disabled and VRAM released.
aligner.wordsReady: Word and segment timestamps are ready.
aligner.selectionLoads: Selecting Word or Segment will load the forced aligner into VRAM for this session.
aligner.notConfigured: No forced-aligner model is configured for this deployment.
timestamp.verboseRequired: Word and Segment timestamps require verbose_json output.
timestamp.languageUnsupported: {language} transcription is supported, but the Qwen forced aligner does not support {language} timestamps.
timestamp.exampleRemoved: {language} example removed because its timestamps are unavailable. Choose another sample or upload audio in a supported language.
timestamp.languagesDisabled: Languages without forced-alignment support are disabled while timestamps are selected.
timestamp.examplesDisabled: Examples without forced-alignment support are disabled while timestamps are selected.
timestamp.noModel: Timestamp output is unavailable because no forced-aligner model is configured.
timestamp.stillChecking: Timestamp support is still being checked. Please try again when inference is ready.
